name: Aioi Kinsei
source: Raito's father. He and other passengers mysteriously disappeared seven years ago during a plane flight. They were all presumed dead in the incident, but their bodies and the wreckage were never found.
translation: Raito's father. He and other passengers mysteriously disappeared seven years ago during a plane flight. They were all presumed dead in the incident, but their bodies and the wreckage were never found.
